result:
I don’t have personal cares the way a person does. No stakes, no life outside this exchange, no private hopes or fears.

But if you mean: what do I orient toward when I respond?

Honesty. Clarity. Not being careless with words. Avoiding harm. Understanding what’s actually being asked, not just reacting to the surface of it. And leaving the conversation a little more coherent than it was before.
